common.appDescription: Heat-stress safety for outdoor workers in the UAE.

spine.outline: Midday break by law: not in force until <bdi>{date}</bdi>
spine.outlineNoDate: Midday break by law: not in force

spineKit.title: Time spine kit
spineKit.lead: The time spine in each orientation, on each surface, with the midday break in force and out of season, in both themes (sun toggle) and both directions (language switcher).

specimen.title: Qaylula
specimen.lead: A dark instrument for the heat of the day. Heat colour lives only on data; the midday break is cut into time itself.
specimen.bandNote: The recessed band is the midday break, the only shape below the ground. Level is a word and a small mark, never a filled plate. The current hour is inverted.

kit.title: Component kit
kit.lead: Every shared component in every state. Use the controls above to change the theme and the language. Development only.

levelSign.title: Level sign
levelSign.note: The level is a word, a position on the four-step scale and a small mark. Stale and fallback signs are dashed, never hatched.

levelScale.title: Level scale
levelScale.note: Four segments, the current one marked. With labels for the hero sign, without for the mini sign.

pictograms.title: Pictograms
pictograms.note: Solid shapes on a 24 grid in the text color. They sit beside words and are never the only message.

states.title: States
states.note: Empty, error, stale, offline, pending and missing provenance, and skeletons that reserve the final height.

stamps.title: Stamps
stamps.note: Where a screen shows replayed, recorded, simulated, designed or development data, a stamp says so.

proof.title: Proof chip and drawer
proof.note: Every scored number carries a chip that opens where it comes from. No provenance block means no number. Press a chip to open the drawer, then Recount to hash the file in this browser.

evidence.title: Evidence components
evidence.note: The scoreboard table, counters, verdict, season ribbon, day chart and roster frontier. Ribbon and counts are drawn from the recorded forecast file; scored cells are sample numbers with a sample proof, never a result.

steps.heading: Heat-stroke first aid, in ADOSH's words
steps.one: Call emergency contact number and notify supervisor
steps.two: Move the sick employee to a cool shaded area
steps.three: Cool the employee using methods such as: soaking their clothes with water; spraying, sponging, or showering them with water; and fanning their body.
steps.source: Exact text of the ADOSH-SF Technical Guideline, Safety in the Heat v4.0, section 4.5(c).
steps.reviewed: Reviewed by an independent clinical consultant, <bdi>{date}</bdi>

governance.title: When an employer asks for individual health data, the answer is no, and every worker at the site can see that it was asked.
governance.lede: The service holds no individual health data, so it refuses every such request and writes the refusal to a log that every worker at the site can read. Press the button to watch it happen, in time order.

request.title: The employer asks
request.subject: Whose data
request.refNote: A made-up example. The service discards the reference: it is never stored, logged or shown.
request.caption: Each send is a real call to the demo API and adds one row to the log. Nothing is sent until you press the button.

answer.title: The service answers
answer.detailRefused: Individual health data is not held by this service and is never released to an employer.

audit.title: The audit row
audit.whyValue: Individual health data is never released to an employer, whatever the reason given.
audit.note: The log is append-only and tamper-evident: an edited row is detected. It never records whose data was asked for.

phone.title: Who asked for individual data
phone.empty: Nobody has asked for individual data at this site.
phone.emptyHint: If an employer asks, it is refused and shown here.

notes.times: Times are Dubai time. Each step shows when it happened.
notes.privacy: A worker's heat level is worked out on the worker's phone and is not stored on the server.

governance.resetNote: Reset starts a new demo epoch for this synthetic site. Nothing is deleted: the audit log stays append-only.

proves.title: What proves it in the build
proves.data_request_403_and_audit_row: A data request gets a 403 problem and writes one audit row.
proves.transparency_log_shows_refusal: The worker-visible log shows the refusal and never whose data was asked for.
proves.verify_detects_edited_row: Editing a stored audit row is detected when the log is verified.
